title: Interior singularity and branching of geodesics in real-analytic sub-Riemannian manifolds
summary: We study the regularity and branching of strictly abnormal minimizing geodesics in sub-Riemannian geometry. We construct examples of real-analytic sub-Riemannian manifolds admitting minimizing geodesics that lose regularity at an interior point of their domain and exhibit branching, thereby resolving longstanding open questions. Moreover, using a lifting procedure, we provide the existence of non-smooth and branching minimizing geodesics also in Carnot groups.
